description: This file defines the RelationshipRepository class within the SuiteCRM API, responsible for handling relationship types based on JSON API requests. It includes a method to determine if a relationship is 'to-many' or 'to-one' based on the request data.

classes.name: RelationshipRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing relationships within the SuiteCRM JSON API module.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypeFromDataArray
methods.description: Determines the relationship type ('to-many' or 'to-one') based on the provided JSON API request data array.
